prompt.alinti: This free AI tool turns your cloud code into literally a full production studio, and it's completely free. It's called Open Montage, and it's a fully open-source project with over 60,000 stars on GitHub. It basically works just like a real production team, with a researcher, a script writer, a voice artist, and even an editor, all run by AI. So you just give it a prompt, and a team of AI agents will search the entire internet, write the script, generate the visuals, even pull B-roll, music, voiceovers, and sound effects, and then put everything together into a finished video all on its own. And it works for pretty much any format, from animated explainers all the way up to product ads and UGCs, to even cinematic trailers. So if you want to try this for yourselves, just comment video down below, and I'll DM you the link directly.
